answer_1.quote: We introduce NOVELHOPQA, the first benchmark to jointly vary hop count (1-4) and narrative length, built from 83 novels with four balanced 1,000-example splits.

answer_2.quote: All models score above 90% on average, confirming the validity of most questions. We discard any question missed by any model in the final dataset used in Section 5.

answer_3.quote: All responses were graded by GPT-4.1 (OpenAI, 2024b) using CoT prompting for consistency.

answer_4.quote: Ten undergraduate validators each annotated 260 examples... They rated Alignment, measuring how well each QA pair matched its source context, and judged Hop Match, assessing whether the answer required exactly H reasoning steps.
